name: SCORE San Francisco & East Bay
description: Free and confidential business mentoring plus webinars and workshops from experienced business professionals
fullDescription: SCORE is a nonprofit network of volunteer business mentors affiliated with the SBA. The San Francisco & East Bay chapter offers free, confidential mentoring plus webinars and workshops for small business owners in San Francisco, the East Bay, and Marin.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free one-on-one business mentoring
- Mentors are experienced business leaders
- Webinars, workshops, and courses on business topics
- Online resources and templates
- Guidance on starting, growing, or scaling a business
- Meet by email, video, phone, or online chat
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the SCORE San Francisco & East Bay page on score.org
2. Browse local mentor profiles and areas of expertise
3. Request a free mentoring session online
4. Meet with your mentor (in-person or virtual)
5. Continue meeting as needed—mentoring is always free
keywords: SCORE, San Francisco, East Bay, Marin, business mentor, free mentoring, small business, startup, entrepreneur, business coaching, workshops, consulting
